name: Aaron Moorhead
biography: Aaron Scott Moorhead (born March 3, 1987) is a filmmaker, who works with his filmmaking partner Justin Benson. Alongside Benson, he has served in directing, producing, editing, and acting roles in their projects, while Moorhead is also a cinematographer and Benson is a writer. Their films primarily centre around science fiction or horror elements. The duo have also contributed to several television series within the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
